name: Hasegawa Kodaka
source:
The protagonist, a transfer student who has not been able to make friends in his first month at St. Chronica's. Of all of the members of the club, he is the most gentle, balanced and socially competent in personality; but his unusual hair color, inherited from his late English mother, leads classmates to assume he is a violent and abusive delinquent and spread defamatory rumors about him. Because of his long experience of antagonism, Kodaka has become accustomed to fighting and can defend himself quite well. The reason why Kodaka has a hard time making friends is mostly due to his looks.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boku_wa_Tomodachi_ga_Sukunai]Wikipedia[/url]]
